# Enter in a ui.input commits an edit made since the last commit, then
# submits: @change once per edit, then @submit every time, android's keyboard
# action on every target. A program's write is no edit, and a test's change
# trigger commits without submitting. A test's submit() is the field's Enter.
# Only android wired @submit; fyne and gtk4 committed on every Enter.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    var text = ""
    var order = ""

    ui.vbox {
        ui.input #field(
            :value = text,
            @change(v) { order = order + "c" },
            @submit { order = order + "s" },
        )
        ui.button #set(text="set", @click { text = "abc" })
    }
}

func testEditThenEnterCommitsThenSubmits(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.input("xy")
    c.field.submit()
    t.assert(c.text == "xy")
    t.assert(c.order == "cs")
}

func testEnterAgainUneditedOnlySubmits(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.input("xy")
    c.field.submit()
    c.field.submit()
    t.assert(c.order == "css")
}

func testEnterUneditedOnlySubmits(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.submit()
    t.assert(c.order == "s")
}

func testProgramWriteThenEnterOnlySubmits(t Test, c main) {
    c.set.click()
    c.field.submit()
    t.assert(c.text == "abc")
    t.assert(c.order == "s")
}

func testChangeTriggerDoesNotSubmit(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.change("xy")
    t.assert(c.text == "xy")
    t.assert(c.order == "c")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
